rules: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
All images must have alt text.
Focus states must be visible (ring-2 ring-brand-500).

setup: Remove standard Create-React-App boilerplate (spinning logo, centered text).
Configure Tailwind with the custom colors provided above.
Add the Google Fonts link to public/index.html.
structure: Create a Layout component that handles the Navbar (with Lang Toggle) and Footer.
Use a context or simple state for Language Management (i18n is overkill, just use a JSON object for translations).
Build the Hero, Services, Portfolio, About, and Contact as separate components.
Ensure the 'Get a Free Preview' button opens WhatsApp API link.
styling: Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for Services.
Use the 'Glassmorphism' effect for the Sticky Navbar (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md).
Ensure the Contact Form is display-only (visual only, no backend logic needed as per requirements).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
